description: A Statement of Applicability entry marked applicable must have at least one documented risk treatment linked to it via soa_control_ref.
findingText: Control marked applicable with no documented treatment
resolutionHint: Add a risk treatment record linked to this control before claiming applicability
limitations: Confirms only that a linked risk_treatments row exists for this control_ref — cannot verify the treatment is technically adequate or actually implemented.
Relies on soa_control_ref matching exactly; a treatment linked under a differently-formatted control reference will not be detected as linked.
